notes: Continuation of a discussion of a conjecture: the author calls the previously stated sufficient conditions uninteresting and too platonic, then describes approaching a plausible conjecture through moduli spaces and Teichmüller groups. The text is transcribed rather than mathematically established here.

The author restates conditions for an automorphism of a completed fundamental groupoid to come from Gamma: the lacet condition, then stability for étale coverings defined over K. The final written semicolon is preserved; no sentence continuation is supplied from another page.

No author page number is visible. The thin, lighter lower-left archive folio 99 is retained as a margin note in another unnamed archive hand. H’s editorial page identification and notes are not manuscript text and are excluded from substantive comparison counts.

The diagonal note begins with the charrue/bœufs idiom and seeks algebraic conditions determining Gamma. Its plural algébriques after nature is preserved. Operations on a set provide a contextual preference for opérations at the genuinely ambiguous underlined noun; this is not an independent mathematical proof check.

The short final margin word is left as purement|seulement followed by the three visible points. No grammatical completion is invented. Small crossed portions of du, groupoïde and the formula’s K remain explicitly doubtful.

C’s alleged added sur les sous-groupes profinis de Pi and canceled pour les are not separable marginal writing. The corresponding visible marks follow oblique body lines, including multiplicités MD and Teichmüller. They are therefore not duplicated as additions or deletions in the margin inventory.

The first-reading whole image and both native overlapping halves were each viewed once. Twelve single-locus crops were saved; existing crops were reused without recropping. No OCR, external research, TeX compilation, or other page was used.

Root independently reviewed the same twelve crops and agreed with the conservative main-body readings, the margin opening, the genuine field-index doubt, and removal of body contamination. Root suggested un ensemble and purement as readings of the lower slanted rows; the reader re-evaluated the existing crop and adopted ensemble while leaving the final word doubtful.

The reading does not establish a separately recoverable old index beneath the current 5, or a separately canceled pronoun beneath il|je. Such retracing is discussed without adding unverified deleted characters.
No mathematical assertion was independently proved, computed, or used as a checked theorem by this reader on this page. Agent reader_c, first reading; model GPT-6 Astra Pro; effort not exposed.

Root checked every substantive disagreement and open place on saved crops, using both native halves for baseline and placement context. Five estimated boxes were mislocated: sont and inserted me were rebound to existing reader crops; the conjecture/intéressante transition, internes and je pense surtout received their first correctly located crops. The unused trial crops are retained as processing history and do not support the corresponding readings. Other small crops can clip peripheral strokes, with the native halves supplying their baseline context. All corrected evidence references point to actual saved crops.
The ordinary set-action terminology used in preferring opérations is explicitly logged as carried background (142-100-B1), not as a proof check. The word itself remains uncertain.

The full second reading localizes the proper-name uncertainty to its u-mark: one connected short dark arch favors û, while ü remains possible as a joined gesture. The transcription explicitly retains both. The main reader independently inspected the first focused crop; familiar spelling is not used to supply two dots.

This updates existing comparison 100-19 while preserving its baseline-versus-insertion finding; no second count is made for that same place. The crossed marginal noun remains independently doubtful.

Auditor and main reader confirm the comma in the existing marginal crop; no comma edit or witness-error count was made.
